create_quantlinear_mlx_layer: create a QuantLinearMLX layer with 4-bit quantization and group size 128 for inference
convert_gptq_to_mlx: convert a GPTQ quantized linear module to MLX format using QuantLinearMLX.from_gptq
run_quantized_forward_pass: run a forward pass through a QuantLinearMLX layer with MLX or PyTorch fallback
check_mlx_availability: check if MLX is available by importing MLX_AVAILABLE from the shim module
unpack_mlx_weight_tensor: unpack a uint32 packed MLX weight tensor back to integer values using _unpack_weight_torch
